/case-study/website-redesign-for-a-non-p.description: Redesigned the site with compelling storytelling and integrated donation.
h1: Website redesign for a non-profit
h2: Development Of AI-Powered Personalized Avatar Generation SaaS
Scalable SaaS platform for a Qatar startup
Tell us what you’re building. We’ll tell you how we’d build and grow it.
p: We collaborated with a mission-driven non-profit organization to redesign its website with the goal of increasing community engagement, improving donor conversions, and enhancing accessibility for a wider audience. The existing site was outdated, hard to navigate, and lacked mobile responsiveness, which limited its impact. The new digital experience needed to reflect the organization's values, clearly communicate its mission, and make it easier for users to donate, volunteer, and get involved.

Our process began with a discovery phase, including stakeholder interviews and user behavior analysis to understand audience needs and internal goals. We developed wireframes and a content strategy that prioritized clarity and emotional connection. Using an agile design and development approach, we tested prototypes with real users, gathered feedback, and iterated quickly. Accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1) were followed to ensure the site was inclusive for all users. Post-launch, we provided training and ongoing support, as well as built-in analytics to track donor journeys, engagement, and content performance.

The primary challenges included outdated UI/UX, poor mobile performance, and unclear navigation that caused friction for users trying to access programs or make donations. Content was scattered across multiple pages, with no clear hierarchy or storytelling structure. Additionally, there was no integration with donation platforms or CRM systems, making campaign tracking and supporter engagement difficult. Budget constraints and limited internal technical resources also required a cost-effective and scalable solution.

We created a clean, modern, and mobile-first website with intuitive navigation and focused calls-to-action. The site structure was reimagined to guide visitors toward key actions—donate, volunteer, and learn more—within the first few seconds of interaction. We integrated a secure donation gateway, volunteer sign-up forms, and a content management system (CMS) that empowered the team to update content without technical help. The design emphasized the organization’s impact through compelling storytelling, visuals, and testimonials, helping to build trust and drive engagement.

The goal was to build a streamlined digital ecosystem that enhanced client experiences, improved operational efficiency, and enabled data-driven decision-making. To solve these issues, we implemented a centralized digital platform that combined CRM, project management, collaboration, and analytics tools into one integrated environment. h1: Development Of AI-Powered Personalized Avatar Generation SaaS
h2: Development Of AI-Powered Personalized Avatar Generation SaaS
Scalable SaaS platform for a Qatar startup
Tell us what you’re building. We’ll tell you how we’d build and grow it.
p: We began by analyzing the core product flow of PFPAvatar, including user onboarding, avatar generation behavior, and credit-based conversion mechanics. This was followed by a technical audit of the system architecture, covering the frontend user experience, backend API structure, database schema, and AI image generation pipeline to identify performance and scalability gaps.

Based on these insights, we implemented a structured product strategy focused on improving conversion and retention. This included refining the onboarding flow, optimizing the image upload and style selection experience, and introducing a clear credit system that aligns usage with generation cost.

This implementation not only delivered a fully functional AI avatar SaaS but also established a scalable foundation for future expansion into higher-volume SaaS offerings, API access models, and advanced personalization features.

PFPAvatar is an AI-powered SaaS platform that lets users generate personalized profile pictures and avatars from a single uploaded photo. Built for creators, professionals, and brands, the product focuses on fast generation, clean UX, and a simple credit-based usage model that makes avatar creation easy to scale.
Designed and launched a conversion-focused avatar generation flow
Implemented a credit system to manage user usage and monetization
Integrated secure authentication, image storage, and AI generation workflows

Our agency faced several key challenges while building PFPAvatar, primarily around stabilizing the AI image generation pipeline under inconsistent inference times and ensuring reliable, fast user feedback. Designing the credit-based system also required careful coordination between authentication, database logic, and generation services to prevent issues like double spending or failed transactions. On the product side, we had to optimize the user experience for long-running AI processes by managing upload states, loading feedback, and result delivery without breaking flow. Integrating multiple services such as Firebase Auth, Supabase Storage, PostgreSQL, and external AI models into a single cohesive system added additional complexity, requiring strong error handling and consistency across the entire stack.

PFPAvatar already had a strong core system for AI avatar generation, but needed optimization across user flow, system reliability, and monetization structure. The product lacked a fully refined conversion journey, and the generation pipeline required stabilization for consistent performance at scale.

We built a structured product foundation by refining the onboarding and avatar creation flow, introducing a clear credit-based usage model, and optimizing the dashboard experience for faster interaction and better usability. On the technical side, we stabilized the AI generation pipeline, improved queue handling, and ensured reliable integration across authentication, storage, and database services.

In today’s digitally driven manufacturing environment, data is as valuable as physical assets. From CNC programs and design files to supplier records and production analytics, sensitive information flows across machines, teams, and cloud platforms every day. Without proper safeguards, this data becomes vulnerable to breaches, downtime, and operational disruptions that can directly impact productivity and customer trust.
Regularly back up critical manufacturing and operational data
Keep software, firmware, and machine systems up to date
Monitor networks and machines for unusual activity
Implementing strong data security practices ensures that intellectual property, production data, and client information remain protected across every stage of the manufacturing lifecycle.

Modern manufacturers must adopt a layered security approach that combines technology, processes, and employee awareness. This includes secure network infrastructure, controlled system access, regular data backups, and continuous monitoring.
Use encryption for data stored on servers, machines, and cloud platforms
Restrict system access based on employee roles and responsibilities
Train employees to recognize security risks and best practices

“In modern manufacturing, data security is not just about protecting information it’s about protecting uptime, quality, and trust. A single data breach can halt production, compromise intellectual property, and damage long-standing client relationships. As factories become increasingly connected through smart machines, safeguarding data becomes essential to maintaining operational continuity.

By building security into daily operations rather than treating it as an afterthought, manufacturers can reduce risk, maintain compliance, and ensure uninterrupted production even in the face of evolving cyber threats.
